preFixFinding.symptom: A removed member still received 200 from a warm isolate during the 5000ms positive-role cache TTL.
preFixFinding.cause: The request middleware cached positive membership roles and did not observe D1 revocation until cache expiry.

fix.behavior: Resolve current Space membership and status on each protected request; include the authenticated tenant in the lookup.
fix.queryShape: One joined D1 query replaces the prior two lookups; no positive membership result is cached.
fix.regressionCoverage: Local real-D1 test revokes the owner row then asserts the immediately following request is 403; unit test asserts one D1 lookup per authorized request and checks tenant mismatch.

artifacts: Local Wrangler real-D1 runtime acceptance log at /tmp/naelao-batch2-runtime-after-fix.json
limitations: Authorization now performs one current D1 lookup for each protected request. Load impact on the production D1 topology remains to be measured; any future cache must use revocation-aware invalidation rather than a positive TTL-only grant cache.
No remote Cloudflare deployment, production identity provider, or live provider call was exercised.
Signup, account recovery, session rotation, and tenant deletion lifecycle remain outside this batch.
